text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her debut race is over, I discuss
our next
race goals with Satono
Diamond.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since her goal is becoming an illustrious
runner
capable of winning G1 races,
going for
junior-level G1 races seems
like an appropriate
choice.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try competing in the Classic
Triple
Crown.
choice_data_list: Do you have any preferences for our next race?
Do you have any preferences for our next race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
It's true that I'm aiming to win a G1 race,
but that
is but one part of my greater
goal.
choice_data_list: Not a Junior Class G1 race?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The illustrious runner that the Satono
family
envisions is one who contributes
to the
development of the Umamusume
racing world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As you know, the Satono family strives
to support
Umamusume through
managerial and
philanthropic work.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Sending out an illustrious runner who
wins G1
races is just another way we
hope to contribute to
the world of
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
My goal is to become a pillar that
supports the
community and its racing
culture from the inside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To this end, I concluded that following
the tried
and true path would be best. If
I can create a
buzz during the Classic
Triple Crown, it'll
contribute to the
Umamusume world.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
So, if possible, I'd like to make full
preparations
for the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we're able to thoroughly prepare, it
would
indeed make more sense for her
to go directly for
the Satsuki Sho instead
of any junior races.
choice_data_list: Our next goal is the Satsuki Sho?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes. What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see no reason to disagree with her.
Winning the
Classic Triple Crown
achieves our goal of winning
a G1 race
as a matter of course. Still...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? Why are you staring at
me like
that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You mean in relation to my goal? Well,
it's the
reason I was born, after all. I have
no room for
doubt.
choice_data_list: Just thinking how you never waver.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of, I just realized I've never
told you
why my parents and I are so
determined for me to
become illustrious.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
As I explained earlier, the Satono family
has
always passionately contributed to
the
development of the Umamusume
world, but we've
yet to produce a truly
great runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
None of the Satono Umamusume who
raced
before me managed to win a G1
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
At some point, people started referring
to it as
the "Satono jinx."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Moreover, there was a long period
where the
family gave birth to only
males, and not a single
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
People within the family began to
whisper that
the lack of Umamusume
being born was also due
to the jinx.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I broke that jinx when I was born.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I was born to realize the Satono family's
dream.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Because my parents occupy a central
position
within the Satono group, I've
received a great
deal of support ever
since I was young.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The expectations my whole family has of
me are
what made me the person I am
today.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: They are my source of strength!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's why I must live up to their
expectations.
That is my dream! I cannot
afford to have any
doubts!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I know I can be the one who breaks the
jinx that
prevents Umamusume of the
Satono family from
winning G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And I'll prove it by winning the Classic
Triple
Crown!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! Right. First off, we'll have to
conquer
the Satsuki Sho.
choice_data_list: Understood. Let's aim for the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If we're taking on the Classic Triple
Crown tour,
we'll need to prepare not
only for the Satsuki
Sho, but also the
long-distance Japanese Derby
and
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We should be okay if we start preparing
now.
We'll just keep making adjustments
for next year's
Satsuki Sho while
focusing on our upcoming races.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's my warm-up done. Now, our first
exercise
for today is...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ahhh! Dia! Dia!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! What's wrong, Kita? Why are you
so
worked up?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I saw your debut race!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't able to watch you in person, but
I saw a
recording of it! It was sooo
exciting!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I watched it on the big TV in the dorm
with the
others, and I got so into it, I just
started cheering
for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone got mad at me because I was
being too
loud.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
But it was because your race was such a
nail-biter!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! That's so like you. Thanks for
cheering for
me!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Watching you run made me feel a
different kind
of happiness than when I
had my own debut race.
I got so pumped
up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Your expression was nothing like the
way you
usually look during scrimmages
and partner runs.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It really sank in then that you'd finally
caught up
to me...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. And sorry for making you
wait for so
long!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Now that you're hot on my heels, I
can't
afford to let my guard down!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I didn't win the Satsuki Sho or the
Japanese
Derby, but I'm going to win
the Kikuka Sho for
sure!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
As your older sister figure, I have to
make sure to
win a G1 first!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my next goal is also the Classic
Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Really?! No way!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is. So I'll be studying your
performance in
the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hngh! Then I really can't afford to lose! I don't want to set a poor example for you!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to get back to training! Catch
you later!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best in my races as well! Just
wait for me
a little longer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: You got it! Let's both rock it out there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black blusters away like a mighty
storm.
She has a strange power to
energize people she
speaks to.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. When we were young, we promised
that we'd
always run together.
choice_data_list: If I recall... you promised to run together, right?
If I recall... you promised to run together, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita was the first person my age I'd met
who was
stronger than me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
We quickly became friends. I didn't
know much
about the outside world, but
she took me to all
kinds of places.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've been chasing after Kita since forever
ago...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
And I've always dreamed of catching up
and
overtaking her.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She's my friend, but she's also someone I
want to
beat.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
She's an incredible person. She
possesses a
tenacity or, perhaps, a
gutsiness that I don't.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. You get it too, huh? It's a shame
she
couldn't win the Satsuki Sho or the
Japanese
Derby...
choice_data_list: I feel like I kind of get it...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
But Kita isn't someone who gives up
easily. I'm
sure this is just the beginning
for her!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Since she's working so hard, I can't
afford to
waste time either. I'm definitely
going to win the
Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Listening to her, it's clear Satono
Diamond is all
the stronger thanks to
having Kitasan Black as her
rival.
